components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single affirmative action on a surface; filled from the one interactive accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.2; background-color: hsl(var(--accent)); color: hsl(var(--accent-ink)); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s, opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: hsl(var(--accent-hover)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--accent)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The same box as the primary button with a raised fill; used for every non-committing action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-family: inherit; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.2; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--line) / var(--line-strong-alpha)); background-color: hsl(var(--surface-2)); color: hsl(var(--text-1)); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: hsl(var(--surface-3)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--accent)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: The status and role pill: a tint of its own hue with the text blended toward the theme text colour so it stays AA.
components.css: .ds-badge { --ds-badge: var(--status-verified); display: inline-block; padding: 0.15rem 0.55rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: capitalize; white-space: nowrap; background-color: hsl(var(--ds-badge) / 0.14); color: color-mix(in srgb, hsl(var(--ds-badge)) 75%, hsl(var(--text-1)) 25%); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--ds-badge) / 0.3); } .ds-badge.is-stall { --ds-badge: var(--status-needs_clarification); }

components.name: Frosted Panel
components.description: The system's one floating surface: translucent fill, blur, hairline border, inset top highlight. Never nested.
components.html:
Needs attention

3 reports have waited over 7 days.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 0.875rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background-color: hsl(var(--surface-1) / 0.66); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(150%); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--line) / var(--line-strong-alpha)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 hsl(0 0% 100% / 0.06), 0 16px 40px hsl(var(--shadow-color) / var(--shadow-alpha)); } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: hsl(var(--text-3)); } .ds-panel-body { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: hsl(var(--text-2)); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Raised fill with a hairline border; focus turns the border accent and draws a one-pixel accent ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: hsl(var(--text-3)); } .ds-input { width: 100%; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.9375rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--line) / var(--line-strong-alpha)); background-color: hsl(var(--surface-2)); color: hsl(var(--text-1)); transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(var(--text-3)); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: hsl(var(--accent)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px hsl(var(--accent)); }

components.name: Navigation Pill
components.description: The floating sticky top bar; active route takes an accent tint.
components.html: Road Accident ReportingDashboardMapReports
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem; margin: 0.75rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.25rem; border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--line) / var(--line-strong-alpha)); background-color: hsl(var(--surface-1) / 0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(150%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 hsl(0 0% 100% / 0.06), 0 16px 40px hsl(var(--shadow-color) / var(--shadow-alpha)); position: sticky; top: 0.75rem; } .ds-nav strong { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: hsl(var(--text-1)); } .ds-nav-links { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav a { color: hsl(var(--text-2)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav a:hover { background-color: hsl(var(--surface-2)); color: hsl(var(--text-1)); } .ds-nav a.is-active { background-color: hsl(var(--accent) / 0.15); color: hsl(var(--accent-text)); }

components.name: Pipeline Stage
components.description: The console's signature control: one lifecycle stage with its status pip, count, and share of the pipeline. Selecting it lenses the view without changing any count.
components.css: .ds-stage { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 8px 10px 9px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--line) / var(--line-strong-alpha)); background-color: hsl(var(--surface-2) / 0.6); color: hsl(var(--text-1)); font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, background-color 0.15s, padding-bottom 0.15s; } .ds-stage:hover { border-color: hsl(var(--accent) / 0.5); background-color: hsl(var(--surface-2)); } .ds-stage:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--accent)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-stage.is-sel { border-color: hsl(var(--accent)); background-color: hsl(var(--accent) / 0.16); padding-bottom: 13px; } .ds-stage-pip { position: absolute; top: 9px; right: 10px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: hsl(var(--status-under_review)); } .ds-stage-name { font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: hsl(var(--text-3)); } .ds-stage.is-sel .ds-stage-name { color: hsl(var(--accent-text)); } .ds-stage-count { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stage-bar { display: block; height: 4px; margin-top: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background-color: hsl(var(--line) / var(--line-alpha)); overflow: hidden; } .ds-stage-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; background-color: hsl(var(--status-under_review)); }

components.name: Situation Strip
components.description: The one-line operational readout every official surface opens with. Instrumentation, not a hero.

components.css: .ds-sit { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 22px; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--line) / var(--line-strong-alpha)); background-color: hsl(var(--surface-1) / 0.66); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(150%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 hsl(0 0% 100% / 0.06), 0 16px 40px hsl(var(--shadow-color) / var(--shadow-alpha)); font-size: 0.8125rem; color: hsl(var(--text-2)); } .ds-sit span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-sit i { display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; margin-right: 6px; } .ds-sit b { margin-right: 4px; color: hsl(var(--text-1)); font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The system is one instrument panel seen through frosted glass. Every official surface — the operations map, the admin analytics console, the reports and notifications tabs — is the same command centre at a different zoom, so an admin moving between them is panning one console rather than loading another product. Dark is the default state of that room; the light theme is the same room with the lamps on, not a second design.

Density is instrumental, never decorative. A reading is a large tabular number with a small caption under it; a panel answers exactly one question; colour is spent only where it carries meaning (the eight status hues, the severity ramp, the up/down of a year-over-year delta). Everything else is neutral surface, hairline, and text weight. Rank comes from scale, not from hue.

The material is frosted glass on a faint accent and violet glow: a translucent panel fill, a backdrop blur, a hairline border, and a single inset highlight along the top edge. Depth is entirely this stack — there is no skeuomorphic lift, and the glow is the only ornament the system allows itself.
keyCharacteristics: One grammar for every official surface: situation line, title row, readings, then the work panel.
Frosted translucent panels over a faint accent/violet glow; hairline borders and an inset top highlight in place of heavy shadows.
Tabular figures and monospace report references; numbers are the content.
The status and severity ramp is the only saturated colour; nothing else is tinted for decoration.
Dark-first. The light theme is a variant of the same tokens, not a separate palette.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: A saturated hue appears only when it encodes something: a status, a severity, a delta direction, or the single interactive accent. Decorative tint is a defect.

rules.name: The Blend-Don't-Bleed Rule
rules.body: Text on a tinted fill is the hue blended 75% toward the theme's own text colour, never the raw hue. The raw severity hue only reaches about 4.2:1 against its own tint, which fails AA at badge and alert sizes.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-the-Voice Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is scale plus tabular figures, never a display face, gradient, or colour.

rules.name: The Measured-Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for identifiers and measurements — report references, coordinates, values that must align. It is not a costume for "technical".

rules.name: The One Material Rule
rules.body: Glass is the system's only elevation device. Panels are never nested — a panel inside a panel doubles the border and the highlight and reads as a mistake; use the panel's own hairline dividers or a plain column instead.

rules.name: The Glow-Stays-Behind Rule
rules.body: The accent/violet wash is painted behind the glass, never on it, and it never brightens into a decorative wash on a light ground.

dos: Do give a floating surface all four glass properties together: translucent fill, backdrop blur, hairline border, inset top highlight.
Do set every figure in `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` and read rank from scale.
Do blend tinted text 75% toward the theme text colour and keep the raw hue for the dot or bar instead.
Do keep both themes driven from the one token set in `client/src/index.css`, and check a new surface in light as well as dark.
Do state the counting rules next to analytics that depend on them, and label sample data as sample.
Do theme the browser's own surfaces (selection, caret, scrollbars, focus ring) from the same tokens.
donts: Don't nest a panel inside a panel; the doubled border and highlight read as an error.
Don't tint anything decoratively; a saturated hue means a status, severity, delta, or the one accent.
Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons; draw the SVG at one stroke weight.
Don't add a label above a heading to explain it, and don't put a hard offset shadow on anything.
Don't let status or severity ride on colour alone.
Don't animate anything without the matching `prefers-reduced-motion` guard.
